criteria: MVP first: classify every concern as blocking, hardening, or completeness, and report blocking concerns first. A concern is blocking only if the delivered code does not do what the plan's goal and criteria claim, or a claimed result is not supported by the code, tests and records at this commit. "No concerns, and here is what I checked" is a valid answer.

The spec is the approved plan r4; rulings D7 and D8 are the owner's and are not re-argued. Check whether each criterion GO1-C1 to GO5-C4 is met by the code in src/gnd/model/_parsing.py, src/gnd/evolve/outcomes.py, service.py, cli_service.py, models.py, summary.py, src/gnd/discover/narrow.py and src/gnd/commands/evolve.py, by the pages unattended-growth.md and the evolution contract, and by the tests tests/test_go1_evolve_parse_once.py, test_go2_operation_outcomes.py, test_go3_narrowed_proposal.py, test_unattended_growth_guidance.py and test_go5_round_summary.py, as close-results.md claims.

Check the delta: is every listed departure true of the code, justified, and recorded where it says; is any departure from the plan missing from it? D4 refutes part of GO5-C1: check that its reasoning holds against src/gnd/evolve/policy.py.
close-delta.md names code no reviewer has read (commit ff67e11d: narrow.py, summary.py, tests/support/markdown_sections.py). Read that code especially.

Look for an input the change claims to handle that gets a wrong outcome or escapes as an exception other than the refusals each API names: proposals whose operations depend on each other in any order, validation issue paths, D-12 refusals, outcome lists a host passes back, round files, unbound artifacts, and Markdown edits of the guarded page.

Every regular expression, string split, slice and special-case branch the milestone added handles the whole class of input it is given, not only the examples in the tests and fixtures, and none reads structured text that a parser or an existing reader in this repository already reads.
Every concern's evidence must quote one of the three named artifacts; cite code and tests by path and line in the observation.
